args.text: [lane-lynx] Three risks of caching DNS (Domain Name System) answers for too long: (1) Stale addresses: if a site moves to a new server, users keep being sent to the old one, causing outages or errors. (2) Slow recovery from attacks: if a poisoned or hijacked answer is cached, the bad address stays in use until it expires. (3) Slow failover: traffic cannot be quickly redirected away from a failed server, so planned changes and emergency fixes take longer to reach users.

[lane-lynx] Idempotent retries matter because networks fail unpredictably, so a client often cannot tell whether a request succeeded before it timed out. If repeating a request has the same effect as sending it once, the client can safely retry without causing duplicate payments, orders or other double actions.
